source_evidence: Player exact 'Breastplate, **+1 Shield**, **Insignia of Claws**, buy these and negotiate the price' authorizes negotiation, payment and equipment gifts to willing intended companions from immediately preceding offers. Source D324 equipment/property options recovery chunk, confirmed owner-authorized distinct shield and insignia consignments, ordinary fitted breastplate stock; 5etools source PHB2014 p145 breastplate, DMG2014 p200 Shield +1/+2/+3, HotDQ p94 Insignia of Claws, Fenar character/features/inventory and Cirren character/inventory. Mara meaningfully assists each merchant negotiation and Cirren casts Guidance each time. Before actual RNG: bundle DC<15=400/450,15–19=380/425,20–24=360/405,25+=340/385; jeweler DC<15=390,15–19=370,20–24=350,25+=330. Visible genuine Python secrets batch1fe48e684906a9b860f903140af849c1: armorer d20 adv12,16 select16 +7 +d4(2)=25; jeweler adv19,14 select19 +7 +d4(4)=30. Both maximum fixed concessions. Pay340+385+330=1055gp vs1240 ask, save185gp; 336886cp→231386cp. Actual three pieces transferred and equipped, previous ordinary shield retained, no trade-in or sale. No limited V resources spent. G1 commercial local suppliers distinct, G2 player exact authorization, G3 predeclared price tiers, legitimate discounts, actual cash/gear transfer and source-backed mechanics. D324~18:20 Orsaven commercial district. V explicitly purchased three chosen pieces at negotiated prices: fitted mundane breastplate for Fenar340gp, original consigned +1 Shield for Cirren385gp, original consigned Insignia of Claws for Fenar330gp. Total1055gp actually paid, purse3368gp8sp6cp→2313gp8sp6cp once. Both companions willingly accept gifts and equip; Fenar medium armor AC14→16 (14+Dex2, no Stealth disadvantage, Rage and Fast Movement compatible); Insignia no attunement, +1 attack and damage on actual natural weapons/unarmed strikes, magical, no bonus on mechanical greataxe visually Double-Claw Rend. Fenar Beast claws/fangs +9 to hit, 1d6+6 base on each hit, 1d6+8 while raging when Strength melee qualifies; Double-Claw Rend stays +8,1d12+5 base/1d12+7 raging, no extra attacks. Cirren +1 Shield no attunement, replaces equipped mundane shield, AC18→19; old ordinary shield retained in Cirren custody unequipped (not sold or traded). No attunement changes. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 Boots of Elvenkind; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; Mara, coach and four horses healthy. Rest3/6, rations21/feed28, no overnight. Prior recovered loot sold and resupply paid once. Magic consignments sold to V and gifted, no remaining physical shop lot/reoffer. Forecaster's Cloak36 and Bloodhound Amulet240 remain separate unchanged offers. Serpent Dart, Hadiya's Handy Quill, Weaving Wasp Needles follow-ups unconfirmed. Two residential leads: 1450gp merchant townhouse without four-horse stabling; 2250gp Old Crown Ward townhouse with four bedrooms, study, kitchen, gated carriage courtyard, four-horse stabling, secure storage. Both uninspected, no purchase/hold/deposit, title/condition/terms to be checked. Lodging unarranged. Sealed diplomatic invitation and limited credentials V-held; frontier commission remaining300+1300, scholarly300/800, Kestrel custody unchanged; Elara in Caereth, Severin assent unverified. No further quest, travel or purchase. Dice delegated. Await V next choice.
